quest.title: Defender of Childhood Dreams
quest.description: Though the process was winding and awkward, Childe proved able to conceal his identity from his brother. Before Teucer could return to Snezhnaya, Childe agreed to his final request — to tour Liyue's Institute for Toy Research. But in truth, that Institute is...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x725, Primogem x60, Mora x44000, Guide to Freedom x5, Hero's Wit x5, Mystic Enhancement Ore x10

talks.objective: Go to Liyue's Institute for Toy Research

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Here we are — welcome to Liyue's Institute of Toy Research.

dialogues.speaker: Teucer
dialogues.text: Yeah, we're here! I can already hear the sounds of machinery inside. Awesome!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What is this place? And how do you know about it?

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Based on my limited understanding, I believe this is one of Dottore's research facilities.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Dottore is another one of the Fatui Harbingers. He loves tinkering with old things, it's a... personal passion of his. So, he converted these ruins into a Ruin Guard research lab.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? So the Ruin Guards are built by the Fatui!?

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: No. They have much closer connections to the Abyss, so strictly speaking, they're as much our enemies as anyone else's... We just do research, nothing more.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: As to why the Ruin Guards have been moving outside of this area recently... I can only imagine that he's gotten bored of playing around with them, and has lost interest in this place.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, yet another Harbinger with a bad attitude!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But at least this explains why you were totally okay with bringing Teucer here. Seems you did your homework ahead of time.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Well... I wouldn't go quite that far. I actually have no idea what this place is like on the inside.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: W—Wait, so... are you or are you not worried about your brother's safety?

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Of course I am... But no matter what the danger is, I will parry it. Isn't that what any older brother would do?

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Even Teucer understands that, now he knows what he's fighting for... It's the very same reason that has nestled in my own heart for so many years...

dialogues.speaker: Teucer
dialogues.text: What are you guys chatting about? Come on, let's go in!

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Haha, alright. Follow me.

talks.objective: Enter the Institute for Toy Research

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Hey.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Childe? So you were here this whole time. What are you hiding for? Why didn't you come and say goodbye?

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Partings are special moments. If he spent his final moments in Liyue seeing me all haggard and weak like this... That's not a memory I want him to leave with.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Still, it is a shame that I couldn't see him off by myself...

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: *sigh* I should have been the one taking him back. I do have subordinates to escort him, but I still feel a little uneasy.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Geez, don't you think you've spoiled him enough already?

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Haha. I can't quite explain it, but somehow I felt much more at ease leaving him in your care. And to think that not long ago, we...

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Ah, yes. I almost forgot. Remuneration for your services — which I really couldn't have done without this time.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aha, so you do have a heart after all!

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: One other thing: don't forget our promise, now. Let's have a rematch when we get the chance.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: —This time, with my honor as a Harbinger on the line.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You'd best go rest up first! Don't come crying to us when you lose all over again!

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Hahaha... Regardless of who wins or loses our next bout, I'd also like to invite you over to my home.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: I'll introduce you to my other siblings, Tonia and Anthon. They're great kids, and I'm very proud of them both.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We'll take you up on that offer! Mostly because we already made a pinkie promise to Teucer.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Haha, I'm sure that he'll be very excited to see you too. Well, that settles it. I'm looking forward to it, now...

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Farewell, my friends — till we meet again, in Snezhnaya.

choices.text: I'm not gonna lose to you.

talks.objective: Protect Teucer, find a way to meet up with him

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Phew, back together at last. You're not hurt, are you, Teucer?

dialogues.speaker: Teucer
dialogues.text: Hurt? No way. This was really fun!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Fun for you, maybe — we were all scared to death...

dialogues.speaker: Teucer
dialogues.text: What's over there... Wow, this room is huge! Is this where Mr. Cyclops takes his friends when they come to visit?

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: It is. Impressive, isn't it? Now, how about a little game of hide-and-seek?

dialogues.speaker: Teucer
dialogues.text: Uh... Now? But...

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Hehe... I have a surprise for you, you know.

dialogues.speaker: Teucer
dialogues.text: A surprise! What sort of surprise?

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Don't worry, you'll have the chance to look for it later. But before that, you have to close your eyes, turn around, and count down from 60.

dialogues.speaker: Teucer
dialogues.text: Okay... 60 is a really long time, though.

dialogues.speaker: Teucer
dialogues.text: Oh, the door opened! Was that you?

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: That's right. But give me a moment over here, Teucer. I need to make sure that everything's safe...

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: *sigh* Maybe I shouldn't have spoiled him quite so much.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Teucer, see that big stone cube in front of you? I need your help.

dialogues.speaker: Teucer
dialogues.text: Yay! Do I really get to help my big brother out?

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: You bet. Now, I'll count down from three, and then we touch it together. Ready? Three... two... one...

dialogues.speaker: Andrei
dialogues.text: #{M#Sir}{F#Ma'am}, young master Teucer, I've been waiting for you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Did Childe send you?

dialogues.speaker: Andrei
dialogues.text: That's correct. Master Childe instructed me to arrange for young master Teucer's return trip. Please come this way...

dialogues.speaker: Teucer
dialogues.text: Who're you? My big brother always tells me never to go off with strangers!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But you've been following us around this whole time...

dialogues.speaker: Teucer
dialogues.text: #Yeah, that's because I've known who you are all along, {M#Mr. Nice Guy}{F#Ms. Nice Lady}.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um... What?

dialogues.speaker: Teucer
dialogues.text: My brother told us all about you in a letter he sent back home. Sister Tonia read it to me.

dialogues.speaker: Teucer
dialogues.text: I actually recognized you the moment I saw you. I just... couldn't remember your name.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What a strange twist of fate.

choices.text: It was a pleasure meeting you too, Teucer.

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: Hee-hee...

response.speaker: Andrei
response.text: Young master Teucer, the boat to Snezhnaya will dock soon. We'd best prepare for boarding.

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: Gee, time really flies when you're having fun...

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: #Well then, see you, {M#Mr. Nice Guy}{F#Ms. Nice Lady}!

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: I'll wait for you back home. You definitely, definitely have to come visit Snezhnaya sometime!

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: Pinkie promise?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You make a pinkie promise, you keep it all your life. You break a pinkie promise, Paimon throws you on the ice. The cold will kill the pinkie that once betrayed your friend, the frost will freeze your tongue off so you never lie again.

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: Hee-hee... It's a promise, then!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Bye-bye, Teucer! Have a safe trip~!

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: Yeah! Pinkie promise, pinkie promise!

choices.text: Your brother didn't say anything bad about me, did he?

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: Not at all. In fact, he said that if he ever had the chance, he'd quit his job and join you on your adventures!

dialogues.speaker: Teucer
dialogues.text: This... This is everything I've ever dreamed of! It's Mr. Cyclops world!

choices.text: This is the surprise your brother prepared for you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow... He actually pulled it off! And the way he knocked those Ruin Guards around was like they really were kids' toys...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But Paimon wonders if he'll be alright after using Foul Legacy Transformation again...

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: Awesome! Hee-hee!

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: Boy, if these Mr. Cyclopses weren't so big, I'd sure love to take one home.

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: Wait... Where'd he go? Where'd my brother go?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aren't you guys supposed to be playing hide-and-seek?

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: Oh, that's right! I was so excited that I forgot all about our game!

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: #Well {M#mister}{F#lady}, let's look for him together, okay?

talks.objective: Find Childe and talk to him

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: It's a good thing that you two found me first... Looks like using the Foul Legacy Transformation while I was still injured took more out of me than I'd thought...

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: I've no idea what I'd do if Teucer saw me like this — look at me, deflated as a burst balloon...

choices.text: You're not afraid that I might end you right here?

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Haha! As I recall, you have siblings too, yes?

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: I figured that you probably wouldn't take me out in front of my little brother.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Really milking this situation, huh?

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Like I said... I can never pass on an opportunity to test my limits.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: And that's why I, Tartaglia, am always getting stronger. *chuckles*

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Anyway, childhood dreams are all too easily shattered. Even if you just leave them be, they will fall to pieces all by themselves.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: So, someone has to protect them, right?

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: If you make a promise, you keep it, if you make a mistake, you apologize...

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: And if you give someone a dream, you defend it to the end...

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: That is what family is all about, isn't it?

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Aha... Remind you of something, did I?

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: *cough* Ugh...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Quit the tough guy act, already! You need to see a doctor right away, mister!

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: A fine suggestion, but first... I have a little something for Teucer. Please give it to him on my behalf.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh, is this... a Mr. Cyclops action figure?

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Indeed. I had it made to order by a smith some time back. I had intended to give it to him on my return to Snezhnaya, but it seems that it would make a better souvenir at this point.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow... Now Paimon thinks about it, Childe's family are really lucky to have him, aren't they?

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Hah. I'll also need you to explain my abrupt departure to Teucer.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: You'll help me out, won't you?

choices.text: "You make a pinkie promise, you keep it all your life..."

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Hahaha... "The cold will kill the pinkie that once betrayed your friend, the frost will freeze your tongue off so you never lie again."

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Ah, that nursery rhyme brings back so many delightful memories. Teucer taught you that one, did he?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Go in peace.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: ...Alright. Thank you.

choices.text: ...I break a pinkie promise, I get thrown on the ice...

dialogues.speaker: Teucer
dialogues.text: I can't find him anywhere... where did he go...

choices.text: I found your brother a moment ago.

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: Really? Where is he?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: A huge number of people suddenly wanted to buy Mr. Cyclopses!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Y—Yeah, so he had to leave in a real hurry. He didn't abandon you here on purpose.

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: Oh... Th—That's great!

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: But still, I was kinda hoping we could play here a little longer...

choices.text: This is for you. From your brother.

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: Wow! Look at this!

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: I never knew that they made Mr. Cyclopses in this size!

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: Look, it even has my name on it! It's my very own Mr. Cyclops!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're really loving it, huh?

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: You bet! My brother is the best big brother ever!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You had a tour of Liyue, met your brother, visited the Institute of Toy Research, and got yourself a souvenir... Now that's what we tour guides call the perfect trip.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Do you think you're ready to head back to Snezhnaya now?

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: Hehe... Don't worry, I know I can't get my way all the time. That'd just be annoying for everyone else.

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: So... let's go!

choices.text: Mr. Cyclops will keep you company in his stead.

response.speaker: Teucer
response.text: What? Why... why would he leave without me?

dialogues.speaker: Teucer
dialogues.text: Brother... someone was saying that Mr. Cyclops is a killing machine...

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Were they, now? What a silly thing for them to say... And you shouldn't go repeating it either, Teucer, you're far too young to be talking about such violent topics.

dialogues.speaker: Teucer
dialogues.text: Yeah, I knew that they were lying, anyways. Mr. Cyclops is here to defeat the bad guys and protect the world. He's my favorite toy!

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Right. With Mr. Cyclops around, the bad guys won't ever get you.

dialogues.speaker: Teucer
dialogues.text: Hee-hee, that's right! Okay, I'm going to go play with Mr. Cyclops now!

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Hey, Teucer, wait up...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Th—The door's shut! Will Teucer be alright?

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: There's another path over there — let's move!
